<!-- pr-reviewer: 477d5aa4313212ceb477b7f2e20c69c0eb1b3eca -->

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge**

## What looks good

- Mach3: `sequenceNumberStart` is now `max: 99999`, and `nextSeq()` refuses N above 99999 with one counted warning; the app's post blocks on a warning, so the refusal is visible to the operator.
- Mach3: the header line now writes `G64` (path mode, #4148 item 2). The G64 change is the only golden movement.
- Mach4: a smoothing request now gives one operator note per program, using the same pattern as Mach3 (`smoothOn` / `smoothOff`), with the control spelled correctly (`MACH4`).
- The 20 `.nc` goldens each moved in exactly one line (line 2, `G64` appended); no other line moved. The 13 app goldens and 7 post goldens match the "Goldens moved" list in the body.
- Every way the change can bite is pinned: `mach3_header_writes_g64_path_mode`, `mach3_sequence_numbers_cap_and_refuse_over_99999`, `mach4_smoothing_request_emits_operator_notification_comment` all fail when the fix is removed (mkinney's mutations on the previous head, unchanged fix shape).

## Results (locally, trial merge with origin/main 1c0152c9, conflict-free)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test mach3_post --test mach4_post` | pass, 10 passed (2 + 8) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_mach3 --test script_mach4` | pass, 11 + 11 |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test wcs_flip --test wcs_flip_dialects` | pass, 16 + 9 |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test conformance` | pass, 7 passed (the suite that was red on the previous head: goldens now regenerated and match) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light` (release, sccache) | green, 6/6 steps, 0 failed (build 80s, motion light: lib 340s, adaptive island 50s, neck 22s, parallel 14s, app pocket_pass_start 8s) |

Trial merge: conflict-free; no conflicts in code. Local review only, no merge pushed.

Heavy lanes: not owed. This is a P7 PR (post header/limit/note text); no toolpath or geometry change reaches a heavy lane, and `P7` gets no targeted heavy step per AGENTS.md. Example catalog suites were not run: no example catalog case uses the Mach3/Mach4 posts (verified by grep - the posts are not exercised by `examples/catalog/`); the post-side pinning tests and the conformance golden suite cover the diff exactly.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `crates/post/tests/mach4_post.rs` ends with an extra blank line after the new test; cosmetic.
- The new test file `crates/post/tests/mach3_post.rs` carries a provenance and gate-map header and a one-line reason in the body ("Test organization" section). It reads "safety blocks", which the two tests do not cover; wording, not content.
- The previous review's requested items (Mach3 goldens, not a "Goldens moved" list, Mach4 control name, new-test-file reason, the mach4_post conflict) are all addressed in this head.
- The global `nRefused` / `smoothNamed` flags make the refusal/note once per program, not once per section - the same pattern as Mach3 already, so the behaviour is consistent; a multi-section program states the limit once.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
